svg.title: CLAMP: learn, interpret and reuse gene modules to connect genetic risk to biological function
svg.desc: A, varied cell types, tissues and treatments contribute samples to an expression matrix Y, approximated by gene loadings Z times sample activities B. CLAMPfull refines expression-only CLAMPbase with curated gene sets. B, the top one percent of genes in a selected Z column and high-activity samples in the corresponding B row support interpretation. C, new expression, TWAS and LINCS data are mapped using fixed Z; gene-level genetic and drug signatures enter a shared module space for drug-disease scoring. D, an example lipid module links cell context, traits and experimentally supported genes. A categorical evidence matrix summarizes five lipid-screen genes lacking nominal individual TWAS signals for the corresponding module-associated traits. All other matrices and coordinates are schematic.
svg.metadata:
Original editable vector artwork. Conceptual and visual references: doi:10.1016/j.cels.2019.04.003; doi:10.1038/s41592-019-0456-1; doi:10.1038/s41467-023-41057-4; doi:10.1146/annurev-biodatasci-103123-095355. No source artwork reproduced. Manuscript source: September 10, 2026 draft supplied by user. The prior-guided refinement arrow is conceptual; no unverified Z=CU constraint is asserted. The case study uses GM1226, DGAT2, APOE and PLTP as described in the manuscript. The categorical screen/TWAS matrix is not a quantitative association heatmap.
CLAMP: learn, interpret and reuse gene modules to connect genetic risk to biological function
